subject: Cartly trial: technical integration & success criteria (next steps)
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@cartly.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + trial success criteria

Hi Oliver — great call earlier. Thanks for walking through the primary Cartly use cases (checkout recommendation and real-time upsell). This thread is to capture an initial integration plan, owners, and success criteria so we can kick off the trial this month.

Summary of what we heard:
- Two integration paths: (1) synchronous generate API for single-shot upsell prompts, (2) streaming chat/assistant route for multi-turn checkout assistance with tool calling to fetch product metadata.
- Expected peak QPS for evaluation: ~30 rps (burst to 80 for promos).
- Target latency for customer-facing upsell: 150–200ms p50 token generation.
- Data concerns: Cartly needs contract-level data isolation and audit logs.

Proposed success criteria (initial):
1) Latency: median generation ≤200ms for 64-token responses under 30 rps sustained.
2) Quality: precision@1 of recommendation model ≥ 78% vs your current heuristic (we'll use your evaluation set).
3) Stability: <1% error rate over a 48-hour soak with traffic shape you provided.
4) Observability: request-level tracing + per-route token/cost telemetry in Console.

Integration plan (high level & owners):
- API/SDK integration (Evelyn / Ben): provide samples for Python/Node SDKs, sample routes: POST /v1/generate, POST /v1/stream-chat, and example function-calling binder for product_lookup(tool). Goal: end-to-end demo in 7 business days.
- Streaming & tool-calling (Marcus): wire up streaming client to support server-sent events + incremental tokens; implement tool-calling for product metadata (Cartly will host a product_lookup endpoint).
- Security & compliance (Oliver + Evelyn): exchange SOC2 evidence and confirm KMS integration details; Redwood to provide audit-log export config.

Immediate next steps:
- Oliver: share a small anonymized eval set and an example product_lookup API (OpenAPI or Postman) by Wed 10 Feb.
- Cartly: confirm desired region (us-west) and whether they require VPC/private deployment for the trial.
- Redwood (Ben): attach integration matrix and SLA draft (below).

Attachments: Cartly_POI_integration_matrix.xlsx; SLA-draft-Redwood-Cartly.pdf

Thanks — I'll follow up with a short calendar invite for a tech kickoff once we have the eval set.

— Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@cartly.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@cartly.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + trial success criteria

Thanks Evelyn — this is exactly the level of detail we wanted. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Eval set: I'll send a sanitized sample (500 records) + your evaluation rubric by EOD Wed (10 Feb). We will add expected labels for recommend vs no_recommend so you can run precision@1.
2) Region: confirm US-west is fine — we prefer single-region for the trial.
3) Product_lookup: Priya will expose a sample product_lookup endpoint (GET /v1/product/{sku}) and a small OpenAPI spec. We plan to host it in our staging cluster; it returns JSON with price, inventory, and category flags.

One ask: can Redwood provide a streaming example that shows early/top-k tokens and a function-calling template that maps {product_id} from the model to the product_lookup call? That will help our frontend team wire the UX.

Oliver Chen
Head of Product, Cartly Technologies
oliver.chen@cartly.com | +1 (617) 555-2222

Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 15:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + trial success criteria

Hey Oliver — plan to own the streaming/tool-calling prototype. A few notes on implementation that should set expectations: 

- SDKs: we'll provide minimal Python + Node client snippets that show both a blocking POST /v1/generate and an event-stream client for /v1/stream-chat. Code will include reconnect/backoff and token-accumulation logic.
- Streaming semantics: incremental tokens + delta events for tool_call requests. Sample envelope: {type: 'delta', token: 'please', meta: {tool_call: 'product_lookup', args: {sku: '123'}}}. We'll provide a runnable example that your devs can run against staging.
- Model variants: for the trial we recommend starting with the med-latency profile (quantized) that balances cost and p50 latency. If you need stricter latency we'll propose a dedicated pool (requires committed capacity).
- Telemetry hooks: we can expose per-request trace_id and a small webhook to push critical errors to Cartly's logging endpoint.

Timeline (suggested):
- Wed 10 Feb: Oliver sends eval set & product_lookup OpenAPI (you indicated EOD)
- Thu 11 Feb: Redwood provides SDK snippets + initial streaming demo repo
- Mon 15 Feb: Cartly runs initial integration; Redwood available for 3-hour debug window (tbd)
- Wed 17 Feb: 24-hour soak with real traffic shape (we'll coordinate times)

I'll drop a lightweight README in the drive link tonight. If you need the streaming example earlier I can prioritize it.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
